means: A danbooru CROP tag, not a distance: head to feet inside the frame with nothing cut off.
does: Guarantees the whole figure fits, and to fit the feet in the model pulls the camera back - so it silently shrinks the head and simplifies the face as a side effect. Its real job is preventing the crop, not setting the distance. This is danbooru grammar rather than description: full body / upper body / portrait / close-up are one mutually exclusive crop family that the model resolves almost as syntax. Give it two of them and you get a coin flip, not a compromise.
reach_for_it: when the POSE is the point - a leap, a volley, a stance, a fall - and cutting the legs would kill the shot
used_in: the establish clause of shot.purpose; the sakuga and action shots of studio/movies/derby-ep1.json; studio/templates/sports_climax.json, chase_on_foot.json and comeback_moment.json all end their action clause with "dynamic angle, full body"
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
